{{Quote|General, there's something down here with us, and it's not seppies.|Unidentified clone trooper pilot to Mace Windu|<ref name="ZB" />}}
This '''clone trooper pilot''' was present at the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]], one of the most grueling battles of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During this battle, the Republic dropped an [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]], the force of which formed a sinkhole. After the [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|electromagnetic pulse]] wave dissipated, the [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]] (AT-TE) this trooper was piloting fell into the hole, along with several others. He survived the fall but was badly injured. He was later recovered by a rescue party led by [[High Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]. As Windu knelt beside him, the clone informed the general that [[Zillo Beast/Legends|something]] other than [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] was down there.

==Biography==
[[Cloning/Legends|Cloned]] on the water world of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] from the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], this pilot served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="ZB" />

In the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]], he served under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], commanding an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE Tank]] against the approaching droid army. Halfway through the battle, the leader of the [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]], [[Nakha Urus/Legends|Nakha Urus]], authorized dropping an [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]] on the droid army. The bomb created a massive crater, into which this clone and his AT-TE fell. Upon being found by General Windu and his rescue team, this trooper revealed that [[Zillo Beast/Legends|something else]] was down there with them.<ref name="ZB" />

==Personality and traits==
Like his genetic progenitor, Jango Fett, this clone stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="Databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
As with all the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]], this clone was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].
